meta.note: Specs and terms are transcribed from vendor official pages; fields not stated on official pages read “Check the official page”. group values: free (free tier) / trial (trial) / no-free-tier (no free tier). status values: active (free tier) / trial (trial) / no-free-tier (no free tier). cardRequired null means the official page does not state it. planKind has the same meaning as group. hostingType values: static (static hosting) / edge-compute (edge compute) / cdn-edge-security (CDN and edge security) / container-backend (containers and backends). overageBehavior, sleepPolicy, and commercialNote are the overage behavior, sleep policy, and commercial-use note stated on official pages; where not stated, they read “Check the official page”. paidFrom is the paid starting price stated on the official site; where not stated, it reads “Check the official page”.

offers.title: Vercel Hobby free tier
offers.specText: 100 GB Fast Data Transfer; 1M CDN requests; 1M function invocations; 4 CPU hours; separate allowances for ISR, Blob, image optimization, analytics, and more
offers.durationText: Free (the official pricing page does not state permanent)
offers.cardNote: Not stated on the official pages read — check the official page.
offers.limitsText: CDN Requests 1M/month; Fast Data Transfer 100 GB/month; function invocations 1M/month; Fluid Active CPU 4 hours/month; deployment storage 10 GB; 1 developer seat
offers.overageBehavior: No additional usage can be purchased at the cap; the Hobby docs page states a 30-day waiting period after exceeding the limit
offers.sleepPolicy: Not stated on the official pages read — check the official page.
offers.commercialNote: Terms of Service §4: personal or non-commercial use only; Fair Use Guide two-column list (last updated 2026-09-14)
offers.paidFrom: Pro includes a $20 credit (official pricing page)
risks: No additional usage can be purchased at the cap; 30-day waiting period after exceeding the limit
Personal or non-commercial use only (Terms of Service §4)
Content under the Hobby plan can be used for model training (Terms of Service §3; opt-out via settings or Enterprise)
offers.sourceName: Vercel official pricing page · Terms of Service · Fair Use Guide
offers.notes: The Fair Use Guide page has no standalone definition of commercial use.

offers.title: Render free tier
offers.specText: Free Web Service, free Key Value, free Postgres; 0.1 CPU / 512 MB RAM
offers.durationText: Not stated on the official pages read — check the official page
offers.cardNote: Pricing page FAQ: $1 card verification charge, refunded.
offers.limitsText: 750 instance hours/workspace/month; free Postgres 1 per workspace, 1 GB; free Key Value 1 per workspace, in-memory only
offers.overageBehavior: Pauses when instance hours run out; without a payment method, over-bandwidth: service pauses, no charge; Postgres has a 14-day grace period after expiry, then is deleted along with the data
offers.sleepPolicy: Spins down after 15 minutes without inbound traffic; wake-up about 1 minute
offers.commercialNote: Not stated on the official pages read — check the official page.
risks: Spins down after 15 minutes without traffic
Free Postgres expires 30 days after creation; deleted along with the data after a 14-day grace period
750 instance hours/month; pauses when used up
The official page states free instances should not be used for production
